svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Four kinds of lattice."], [1, "Giant ionic: NaCl."], [4, "Giant metallic: cations in a sea of electrons."], [7, "Simple molecular: iodine."], [10, "Giant molecular: diamond and graphite."]]
svg.title: Types of lattice
svg.desc: Four structures: a giant ionic lattice of sodium and chloride ions, a giant metallic lattice with delocalised electrons, a simple molecular lattice of iodine molecules, and giant covalent diamond and graphite.

g.data-info: e.g. NaCl: ions held by strong electrostatic attraction in all directions: high melting point; conducts when molten or dissolved.
e.g. Cu: cations in a sea of delocalised electrons: conducts as a solid; malleable.
g.text: delocalised electrons: conducts as a solid

g.data-info: e.g. I₂: strong covalent bonds within molecules, weak forces between: low melting point.
g.text: strong covalent within; weak forces between: low mp

g.data-info: Diamond: each C bonded to 4 others, very hard. Graphite: layers of hexagons with delocalised electrons: conducts, slippery. SiO₂ similar to diamond.
